### Get Started with Muse Spark Open
Source: https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/latest/get-started/advanced/get-started-muse-spark-open.html
Muse Spark Open is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) causal language model with 42B active parameters, built for multimodal reasoning. It accepts text, image, video, and audio input through perception encoders, generates text output, and supports a 1M-token context window.

### POST /v1/messages
Source: same page
Anthropic-compatible endpoint /v1/messages. model e.g. "meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4". `thinking` block: if omitted, reasoning is disabled. `output_config.effort` accepts low/medium/high/xhigh.

### Configure Reasoning (muse-spark)
reasoning_effort: low/medium/high/xhigh, default xhigh; disable via reasoning_effort "none" or chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false}; reasoning_content in non-streaming responses; reasoning tokens count toward max_tokens; small max_tokens at xhigh can yield only reasoning (finish_reason length, empty content); KNOWN BEHAVIOR: temperature 0 + xhigh can loop reasoning until max_tokens with empty content (greedy decoding artifact, not a NIM/cache defect); model card recommends temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k disabled; for tests needing temperature 0 use reasoning_effort medium or lower.

### Interact with the API (nemotron-3.5-super-vl page)
Source: https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/latest/get-started/advanced/get-started-nemotron-3.5-super-vl.html
NIM exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions, /v1/responses; Anthropic-compatible: /v1/messages, /v1/messages/count_tokens. All support streaming. Shared /v1/messages examples use 64/256-token budgets which this model can spend entirely on reasoning (stop_reason max_tokens); set max_tokens >= 4096 for those examples.

### Model-Free NIM > SGLang
Source: https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/latest/reference/support-matrix.html
nvidia/sglang-model-free-nim validated for GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B; experimental variant validated for Muse Spark Open.
